film.title: THANKSGIVING DRAMA ON THE BRICKS | The Lock Call Thanksgiving Extravaganza
film.description:
The Tops and Bottoms crew hosts Thanksgiving dinner at The Window, and management shows up.

Edwin wants to know what this joint actually is, so the boss explains Hardwood Bricks in three courses: mid-major college basketball every single night, 27 conferences, an anchor for every school, four handicappers and eight picks a night, the films, the weekly papers and Mateo's sleep videos. He would get through it faster if he could stop looking at Mateo. Tiffany would like to be looked at. Merv would like everyone to leave the bird alone. Then somebody walks in.

As the Brick Turns.

This is a comedy skit. Every character is fictional and the voices are AI, including an AI clone of Matthew Hagan's voice as the boss at the table. The voice at the door is really his. The site screenshots are real. Original music.

The Lock Call is the two-minute daily podcast from Tops and Bottoms. New picks every morning at https://hardwoodbricks.com/tops.html and on Spotify: https://open.spotify.com/show/6BaVf8OcQ7o9DolUwjXzFG

21+. If gambling's a problem, call 1-800-GAMBLER.

Keep it mid. Keep it real. See more at https://hardwoodbricks.com
